```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)

links <- tribble(
  ~name,                            ~url,                                  ~logo,                                               ~fill,
  "Poetry Foundation",              "https://www.poetryfoundation.org/",   "images/poetry-foundation-logo-horiz-1024x275.jpeg", FALSE,
  "DABE",                           "https://www.dabedenver.org/",         "images/dabe.jpg",                                   TRUE,
  "Electronic Frontier Foundation", "https://www.eff.org/",                "images/eff.svg",                                    FALSE,
  "The Overhead Wire",              "https://theoverheadwire.com/",        "images/overhead-wire.svg",                          FALSE,
  "Volts",                          "https://www.volts.wtf/",              "images/volts.png",                                  TRUE,
  "Transportation for America",     "https://t4america.org/",              "images/t4a.png",                                    TRUE
)

cards <- map(seq_len(nrow(links)), function(i) {
  logo_class <- paste("link-logo", if (links$fill[i]) "link-logo-fill" else "")
  tags$div(
    class = "card h-100",
    tags$a(
      href  = links$url[i],
      class = "card-body d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center text-decoration-none",
      style = "background-color: #fff;",
      tags$img(
        src   = links$logo[i],
        alt   = links$name[i],
        class = logo_class
      )
    )
  )
})

tagList(
  tags$div(class = "link-grid", cards)
)
```
